stories.title: Trump suspends Russia sanctions ahead of implementation
stories.summary: Donald Trump issued an executive order on Friday night that suspended a number of sanctions on Russia scheduled to take effect two days later. The sanctions had been passed by Congress and signed into law by the president in September. The move drew criticism from U.S. lawmakers and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, while Russian envoy Kirill Dmitriev described the order as historic.
stories.why: The suspension could reshape diplomatic and economic dynamics among the United States, Russia and Ukraine.
stories.previousTitle: Trump suspends upcoming Russia sanctions as tensions with Ukraine rise
stories.previousSummary: President Donald Trump issued an executive order on Friday night to suspend a set of sanctions on Russia that were slated to take effect two days later, drawing criticism from U.S. lawmakers. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said the move shows a complete disregard for the sanctions, while Russian envoy Kirill Dmitriev called it a historic moment. The suspension follows a U.S. deal to import Russian diesel, further straining Washington‑Kyiv relations.

stories.title: India to apply tariff cuts on select New Zealand imports from Oct 20
stories.summary: India will implement duty concessions for certain New Zealand products starting 20 October under the bilateral free‑trade agreement. The measures give zero basic customs duty on sheep meat and impose specific duties on fish, wine, manuka honey and kiwi fruit, while dairy products are excluded. This is the first tranche of concessions notified by India.
stories.why: Trade developments can affect currencies, business costs, market access and the external balance of the economies involved.
stories.previousTitle: India announces first tariff concessions for New Zealand imports
stories.previousSummary: India will start applying customs‑duty concessions on selected New Zealand products from 20 October under the bilateral free‑trade agreement. The concessions give a zero basic duty on sheep meat and reduced rates on fish and wine, while manuka honey and kiwi fruit will be subject to specific duties. Dairy products are excluded from this first tranche of liberalisation.

stories.title: US Secretary of State Rubio to Visit India amid Trade Deal Delays
stories.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio is scheduled to travel to India next week, with meetings planned in Mumbai and Jamnagar that will focus on investment and energy cooperation. The visit comes as the United States and India continue to experience significant delays in finalizing a bilateral trade agreement, citing a range of ongoing challenges.
